# Bid the landings, the rails, and the rise.

> Price a residential ADA-slope wheelchair ramp from the rise, the landings a lineal-foot special cannot see, both-side handrails, surface, demo, and permit — plus walk-away price and proposed-price margin check.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
